metadata.description: Schedule Loss model tracking file for games where one team has a net schedule advantage of 2 or more factors.
metadata.generated_from: schedule-database.json + arena-advantage.json + current Schedule Loss factor rules
metadata.qualifying_threshold: Net advantage of 2 or more factors
metadata.spread_convention: closing_spread_advantaged_team is from the advantaged team perspective. Negative = favorite; positive = underdog.
metadata.grading: Cover when advantaged team score + closing spread > opponent score; Loss when lower; Push when equal.
metadata.workflow: The website determines qualifying games from the model and joins spread/results records by game_id. Null spread/score fields are shown as Pending.
